newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade, dealers said on Friday,

Most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's 1330 GMT release of the U.S. third quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP) figures, which is forecast to be unchanged from the previous quarter's 2.0 percent increase, the dealers said.
"Rates were steady to easier in the morning on some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for tonight's third quarter GDP figures, for more clues to market direction," a local dealer said.
"The numbers have been built into the market and most people have squared or are squaring their positions ahead of the weekend, so I don't think there will be much impact," he said.
In day-to-day rates, weekend, Monday/Tuesday and week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Thursday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, six-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent. -- P.Theseira (65-870-3085)
